title: Goosebumps 2: Haunted Halloween
desc: Two teenage friends find a magical book along with a ventriloquist dummy at an abandoned house. Later, when they bring the dummy home, it comes to life and wreaks havoc in a small town.

title: Blade Runner 2049
desc: K, an officer with the Los Angeles Police Department, unearths a secret that could create chaos. He goes in search of a former blade runner who has been missing for over three decades.

title: Butcher Crossing
desc: A mysterious frontiersman leads men on a perilous buffalo hunt in the Old West. As harsh elements strike, their resolve and sanity are tested in a brutal fight for survival.

title: Monster House
desc: When three young teens try to convince those around them that a house nearby is haunted, their warnings fall on deaf ears. They must now do their best to protect young children from going there.

title: Inferno
desc: After waking up with amnesia in a hospital, Robert Langdon teams up with Sienna Brooks, one of his doctors, to protect the world from the evil plan of a mad scientist.

title: The Bounty Hunter
desc: Milo must retrieve his bail-jumping ex-wife, Nicole. The job gets tougher than he anticipated when Nicole escapes while chasing a lead and they both end up on the run for their lives.

title: Terminator 3: Rise of the Machines
desc: A cybernetic soldier travels back in time in order to take John Connor, a drifter, to safety. Meanwhile, the soldier also has to save Connor's future wife as she is a key to humanity's salvation.

title: Total Recall
desc: Driven by his recurring dreams of being a secret agent, Douglas Quaid visits Rekall, a company that implants artificial memories and gets involved in a procedure that might scar his soul.
